title: Incident Event
description: Vendor-neutral incident event consumed by the on-call agent. Version 1.x is additive only: new optional fields may appear in minor versions and consumers MUST ignore fields they do not understand. A change to the meaning or requiredness of an existing field requires a new major version.

version.description: Schema version as MAJOR.MINOR. Consumers accept any minor version of a major they support.

event_id.description: Globally unique id for this event. Re-delivery of the same event MUST reuse the same id; it is the primary de-duplication key.

idempotency_key.description: Optional producer-supplied key. When present it is used instead of event_id for de-duplication, so a producer can collapse logically identical events that were assigned different ids.

timestamp.description: When the producer observed the condition (RFC 3339).

id.description: Stable incident identifier. All events about the same incident MUST carry the same id.

severity.description: Producer's view of severity. Triage may revise it.

service.description: Primary service the signal was observed on.

labels.description: Free-form key/value labels copied from the source alert.

signals.description: Measurements that triggered or updated the incident.

links.description: Deep links for humans (dashboards, logs, runbooks).

metadata.description: Producer-specific data. Never interpreted by the core agent.
